Genesys es un formato alternativo del TC: Genesys is an alternate TCG format launched on September 22, 2025. Every card has a point cost and your deck cannot go over the tournament cap. It replaces the usual Forbidden & Limited list: instead of banning a card, it makes it expensive.
Cada carta vale entre 0 y 100 puntos y l: Every card is worth 0 to 100 points and most cost 0. The total of Main, Extra and Side cannot go over the cap: 100 points is the standard, and some events use 50, 200 or 0.
En esta página el tope es de 100 y el co: On this page the cap is 100 and the deck builder adds up the points as you build.
No se pueden usar monstruos Link ni de P: Link and Pendulum monsters cannot be used, and the original field layout is used, with no Extra Monster Zones or Pendulum Zones.
La lista de prohibidas y limitadas del T: The TCG Forbidden & Limited list is not used, but the maximum of 3 copies per card still applies.
Los puntos se ajustan según cuánto se ju: The points are adjusted according to how much each card is played. The latest big adjustment was the anniversary one, on October 5, 2026.

Es el modo principal de Duel Links: una: This is the main mode of Duel Links: a fast version of the game, with smaller decks, less life and one Skill per player. It uses TCG and OCG cards, and some have their effects modified for this format.
Main Deck de 20 a 30 cartas y Extra Deck: Main Deck of 20 to 30 cards and Extra Deck of 0 to 9 (it starts at 5 and goes up to 9 with Extra Deck + items).
4000 puntos de vida en lugar de 8000, y: 4000 Life Points instead of 8000, and you start with 4 cards in hand instead of 5.
Solo hay 3 Zonas de Monstruo y 3 de Magi: There are only 3 Monster Zones and 3 Spell & Trap Zones, and there is no Main Phase 2.
Cada jugador puede usar un Skill, una ha: Each player can use one Skill, an ability unlocked per character. Some Skills restrict how you build your deck.
Hay Zonas de Monstruo Adicional como en: There are Extra Monster Zones as in the current rules, but Extra Links are not allowed.
Tiene banlist propia: cartas prohibidas: It has its own banlist: Forbidden cards and shared limits 1, 2 and 3. Across all the cards of the same limit the deck can hold only that many in total (Main, Extra and Side together).
Los mejores mazos, sus recetas y el cost: The best decks, their lists and gem cost are in the Duel Links section. The tiers come from the Duel Links Meta power ranking.
Rush Duel es otro juego de cartas de Kon: Rush Duel is a separate Konami card game, with its own cards and simplified rules. It came to Duel Links on September 28, 2023 and follows the rules of the physical game with a few differences.
En Duel Links el Main Deck es de 30 a 40: In Duel Links the Main Deck is 30 to 40 cards and you start with 6000 Life Points.
Se empieza con 4 cartas y, al robar, se: You start with 4 cards and, when drawing, you draw until you have 5 (if you already have 5 or more, you draw 1). There is no hand limit and the player who goes first draws 1 on their first turn.
Podés Invocar o Setear todos los monstru: You can Normal Summon or Set as many monsters as you want in a turn.
Hay 3 Zonas de Monstruo y 3 de Magias y: There are 3 Monster Zones and 3 Spell & Trap Zones, with no Pendulum Zones or Extra Monster Zones, and no Standby Phase or Main Phase 2.
Cada carta tiene un solo efecto y se apl: Each card has a single effect that applies instantly: there are no chains or targeting. Spells are Normal, Field, Equip or Ritual, and all Traps are Normal.
Existen los monstruos Maximum (tres mons: There are Maximum Monsters (three monsters that are Summoned together as one) and Legend Cards: a deck can hold 1 of each type (monster, Spell and Trap).
Cada jugador puede usar un Skill, y las: Each player can use one Skill, and the cards are exclusive to Rush Duel: they cannot be used in the other modes.
Los tiers también salen del ranking de p: The tiers also come from the Duel Links Meta power ranking, with different cutoffs (12, 7 and 3 points). They are in the Duel Links section, Rush Duel button.
